entries.name: dromad / Cloth Robe / Body / laterality 0
known_issues: Earlier isolated/refined robe and cuff masks exist; re-audit every view under the reset. No completion credit carried forward.

process_log.action: Bound the actual goat-wool robe to Body part 357, laterality 0, instance 604 from the captured Tam body tree.
process_log.review: Read item description and equipped binding; source tile Items/sw_robes1.bmp with foreground &y/detail y. Shale freckles are recorded. Held Shillelagh is a separate entry; no new outfit invented.

process_log.phase: Fixed adult body and actual donor convention
process_log.action: Selected the current unmutated adult dromad base and three actual RimWorld Duster_Male references. Original Qud shape/description govern the closed robe.
process_log.review: Viewed source plate: native garment silhouette and body are distinct from donor open-coat convention. There is no exact donor robe equivalent; long-garment outline/perspective are the documented reference roles. Personal cosmetics stay separate.

process_log.phase: Editable adult dromad robe in all directions
process_log.action: Constructed a closed long robe with separate front/profile/rear SVG geometry around the fixed long neck and hump, exposing the real hands and feet.
process_log.review: Viewed manual suggestions. Directional hump allowance and long hem are present; flat cloth and rough neckline/sleeve seams still need in-context refinement. No body pixels replaced.

process_log.phase: Closed wool robe refined in adult species context
process_log.action: Used the constructed three-view overlay and source plate to refine the single actual Cloth Robe.
process_log.review: Viewed the full generated output: closed long wool garment, sparse tonal freckles, directional sleeve, continuous hump drape and visible original hands/feet. No belt, open coat or staff. Generator reframed the assembled figures; body pixels will not replace the fixed base. Isolated extraction and actual registration remain required.

process_log.action: Reviewed the manual plain-robe silhouette against the selected isolated/refined garment and its final unchanged-body fitting.
process_log.review: The manual suggestion supplied closed garment identity, short broad sleeves, long hem and intrinsic hump allowance. No staff or personal cosmetic was added.

process_log.phase: Refined closed robe selected for cloth only
process_log.action: Selected the in-context wool/freckle treatment after recomposing its isolated cloth on the original fixed body.
process_log.review: Viewed selected fit: whole profile and rear garment follow the torso/hump. Underlying body/head assets are unchanged; the generated mannequin pixels were not used. Current contact remains (256,950).

process_log.action: Retrieved the robe alone, selected complete connected figures, neutralized RGB and opened neck/near-arm coverage with recorded masks.
process_log.review: Viewed source and extracted cloth: no head, hands, feet or copied body outlines. Source sleeve openings alone were insufficient for the near forearm; explicit fixed-body coverage removes the closing cuff and exposes real anatomy. Neck uses actual head alpha rather than broad segmentation.

process_log.phase: Fixed-frame adult fitting and cut ownership
process_log.action: Registered the separate robe in the adult canvas and recomposed body -> garment -> head in every direction.
process_log.review: Viewed enlarged front/profile/rear/mirrored west. The actual forearms/hands and full neck remain visible without copied hand strokes. All rows inherit body dimensions/contact and equipment layer .0007. Shared material height scale .76; profile width explicitly fitted x1.18 to fixed hump/breast landmarks, not auto-centered to alpha bounds. No body distortion or native acceptance.

process_log.action: Viewed enlarged and 48 x 96 assemblies with the current neutral garment on the fixed adult base.
process_log.review: Long closed robe and side sleeve remain readable; hem clears feet. Every production garment RGB channel is grayscale, independent equipment key cloth-robe@Body@0. Shale freckles are neutral tonal material in this tintable source; their described red hue is not baked in. Original foreground &y/detail y ownership is retained.

process_log.action: Kept equip/unequip, tint, facing and native state review behind the every-conversion-generated gate.
process_log.review: No native/game launch. Overall entry remains UNFINISHED.

entries.name: dromad / Shillelagh / Hand / laterality 2
known_issues: User reported staff too small. Later shaft enlargement has not been accepted as resolution; review proportions and grip in every view.

process_log.phase: Exact wooden-stick blueprint resolves generic runtime description
process_log.action: Read Tam Hand part 362/laterality 2 equipped instance 524 and the exact installed Shillelagh object definition, which inherits BaseCudgel.
process_log.review: Installed description specifies hewn wood shaped into a stick with an oaken knot. Captured generic puzzling-device description and differing weight remain preserved rather than silently rewritten. Identification state was not exported. No mutation, clothing or other item is invented.

process_log.phase: Installed Tribal club reference and fixed adult context
process_log.action: Selected the actual Vanilla Weapons Expanded - Tribal LightClub texture as a neutral wooden-club/outline reference, alongside the original Qud glyph and fixed adult dromad robe assembly.
process_log.review: Viewed selected reference and comparison. Rejected the inspected Vanilla Textures Expanded club as a shape reference because of its spikes. Mod package, Workshop id, source texture hash and About metadata hash are recorded. No exact donor Shillelagh equivalent is assumed.

process_log.phase: Editable enlarged knotted stick and held placements
process_log.action: Constructed one axial held-item texture, larger than the historical short staff, and front/profile/rear placements with explicit grip/hand occlusion and front/back depth.
process_log.review: Viewed full suggestion: front grip overlaps the actual right-hand region; profile leans forward to clear the long neck; back reverses screen side and draws behind the pawn. Length is authored, not native measured. Flat knot/grain marks still need refinement, including avoiding a rune-like knot stroke. Same axial texture is reused like a held-weapon graphic; directional placements supply views.

process_log.phase: Wooden knot and grain refined in context
process_log.action: Refined the one enlarged held stick using the actual item description, manual held placements and original/mod reference plate.
process_log.review: Viewed front/profile/back: natural wood-grain knot replaces the rune-like manual stroke, long shaft and authored enlarged scale remain, no metal/spikes/gems. The generated context was reframed and is not a replacement body/robe. Retrieve one complete isolated axial item for exact mechanical placement.

process_log.action: Reviewed the editable oaken-knot stick and its directional grip suggestion against the final fixed-body assembly.
process_log.review: Manual length and grip direction retained; rune-like construction mark was rejected and replaced by natural grain in the refined output. This is one actual Hand item, not a profession costume or generic sword.

process_log.phase: Natural wooden knot selected in fixed context
process_log.action: Selected the refined wooden material/knob from the context proposal, using only the item in the final assembly.
process_log.review: Viewed front, profile, back and mirrored west. Enlarged stick reaches from below shoulder height to near ground in front/back; profile leans ahead of long neck. Original body/robe pixels are unchanged. Natural wood grain has no letter/rune or added magic.

process_log.action: Retrieved a complete upright Shillelagh with the occluded grip reconstructed as continuous wood, then selected and neutralized its complete connected silhouette.
process_log.review: Viewed isolated original and final layers: one knob and continuous shaft, no copied hands/body/robe pixels. Source is neutralized to equal RGB. Directional hand gaps are explicit masks applied after canonical item registration; north remains continuous behind the pawn. One axial texture is the appropriate held-item convention, so no invented front/back item variants are generated.

process_log.phase: Recorded grip, hand coverage and rear depth
process_log.action: Placed the one canonical item using recorded per-facing transforms and the actual fixed hand coverage; recomposed above or behind the unchanged pawn as appropriate.
process_log.review: Viewed enlarged assembly and isolated layers. Front/profile rod is in front with actual hand pixels owning grip occlusion; rear rod draws behind the pawn. Frame/contact and physical dimensions inherit the fixed adult body. Hand masks intersect the real body alpha so they do not erase wood in empty space. West mirrors east under the current bounded art convention; native handedness/state review remains pending.

process_log.action: Viewed all assembled directions enlarged and at 48 x 96 with nearest-neighbor enlargement.
process_log.review: Wooden knot and larger full-length silhouette remain recognizable. Neutral equipment is separate from body and robe, with key shillelagh@Hand@2 and per-facing depth. Authored length and native source-description discrepancy are explicit; no native equip or demographic claim.

process_log.action: Kept native hand binding, movement, facing, equip/unequip and state acceptance behind the all-generation gate.
process_log.review: No game/harness launch. Overall ledger entry remains UNFINISHED.

process_log.review: Viewed all directions. Retains relaxed torso, older neck/knee planes, slight forward head and rounded upper back in side view. Same one head/two arms/hands/two legs/feet; no added mutations, clothing or personal cosmetics.
